instruction: Review the 5 product description documents in the “Product Data” folder, organize the information according to “Product Selection Summary Sheet_Template 2,” and enter the information into that sheet without changing the table formatting. For the display images, include only images of the washing machines with no marketing text; crop them from the original images and embed them in the table. Then enter the information for the three highest-priced products in the table into the “Template” document and place the washing machine images inside the image placeholders, with the top and bottom edges of each image flush with the placeholder. Ensure a reasonable document layout, and do not split any individual product across pages. Finally, rename the Word document “Product Analysis,” add a header reading “Product Analysis” with a long horizontal line beneath the text, and add page numbers; center both the header and the page numbers.

dim1: The deliverables include 1 product selection summary sheet in .xlsx or .xlsm format and 1 Word document in .docx format; both files can be opened, edited, and saved normally.
The Word document is completed using the “Template” document as its basis, and the final file is named “Product Analysis.docx” or has “Product Analysis” as the base filename.
dim2: +3: Excel column widths: the “Product Name” column is 23.42 characters wide; the “Model” and “Core Parameters” columns are 32.81 characters wide; the “Applicable Scenarios” column is 10.82 characters wide; the “Guide Price” column is 12.36 characters wide; the “Display Image” column is 12.08 characters wide; and so on.

+3: Excel Yunxi: Enter “Yunxi 5.0 D3 Front-Load Washing Machine” as the product name and “Yunxi 5.0 D3” as the product model. Enter 4500 yuan as the guide price. The core parameters include a washing capacity of 12KG, width of 595mm, type of front-load washing machine, Grade 1 energy efficiency, depth of 593mm/537mm, and height of 850mm. The applicable scenarios include keywords such as “everyday clothing for large households, care of large home textiles, small B&Bs, and apartment rentals.”

+3: Excel Little Swan: Enter “Little Swan 12KG Front-Load Washing Machine” as the product name and “TG12VE40PRO” as the product model. Enter 3039 yuan as the guide price. The core parameters include a washing capacity of 12KG, width of 595mm, type of front-load washing machine, Grade 1 energy efficiency, and depth of 560mm/585mm. The applicable scenarios include keywords such as “separate washing of outerwear, underwear, and baby clothing for large households, small B&Bs, and apartment rentals.”

+3: Excel Leader: Enter “Leader Triple-Drum Lazy Washing Machine” as the product name and “Leader L10510B12 (Scale Version)” as the product model. Enter 3999 yuan as the guide price. The core parameters include a 10.5KG large drum + two 1KG small drums, width of 600mm, depth of 570mm, type of front-load washing machine, and Grade 1 energy efficiency. The applicable scenarios include keywords such as “everyday clothing for large households; care of large home textiles; small B&Bs; apartment rentals; and high-temperature sanitizing garment cleaning for families with mothers and infants.”

+3: Excel Mijia: Enter “Mijia 8KG Front-Load Washing Machine” as the product name and “Mijia MG80V11D (Front-Load Model)” as the product model. Enter 999 yuan as the guide price. The core parameters include a washing capacity of 8KG, width of 598mm, depth of 495mm, type of front-load washing machine, and Grade 1 energy efficiency. The applicable scenarios include keywords such as “everyday clothing and care of lightweight home textiles for single-person and 2-3-person small households, small B&Bs, and employee dormitories.”

+3: Excel Midea: Enter “Midea 8KG Pulsator Washing Machine” as the product name and “Midea MB80V36DT (Pulsator Model)” as the product model. Enter 846 yuan as the guide price. The core parameters include a washing capacity of 8KG, width of 515mm, depth of 525mm, type of pulsator washing machine, and Grade 1 energy efficiency. The applicable scenarios include keywords such as “everyday clothing and care of lightweight home textiles for single-person and 2-3-person small households, small B&Bs, and employee dormitories.”
+1: Excel text formatting: Enable text wrapping for long parameters and applicable scenarios. Text must not overflow cells, obscure adjacent columns, or be covered by images.

+5: Number of Excel display images: Insert 1 corresponding washing machine image in each of the 5 product rows, for a total of 5 images. Crop each image from the corresponding product image, retaining only the washing machine itself and the necessary background.
